name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN holds Bulambika; no major city fallen
summary: Army and Kabila-led FRN keep fighting in North and South Kivu; no change in control of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira found
state: Fighting between the army and the FRN, the Kabila-led coalition that succeeded AFC-M23, continues in North and South Kivu; monitors reported FRN captures of Bitale and central Bulambika on 8 Nov and the army says it halted the advance and is preparing a counter-offensive (Al Jazeera, 18 Nov). The Doha and Washington tracks have not stopped the violence (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). No major city has changed hands and no direct interstate fighting is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in North and South Kivu face displacement and disrupted health care; MSF has cut staff in Bunyakiri. FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Supply chains for Kivu minerals remain exposed.
rubric_hit: Active fighting (FRN offensive along RN3, Nov); no major city captured or interstate fighting confirmed (Watch)

sources.title: Al Jazeera — DR Congo's rival peace efforts fail to halt violence in the east

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
